title: Perspectives on Test: System Level Test for AI & Data Centers
summary: Ben Mitchel, Senior Director of Product Marketing & Business Development shares his perspective on what next-gen AI demands of test.
body_markdown:
[← Back to Blog Index](https://www.teradyne.com/company/blog)


As AI and data center devices grow in complexity, with multi-chiplet designs and power envelopes in the thousands of watts, testing every device under real-world conditions has never been more important.


In this episode,[Ben Mitchel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ben-mitchel-9833a41/) , Senior Director of Product Management and Business Development for Integrated Systems Test, discusses why system-level test is now mission-critical in high-volume manufacturing and how Teradyne’s Titan HP platform delivers the power, thermal management, and throughput that AI and cloud infrastructure devices require.[Contact us](https://www.teradyne.com/company/contact-teradyne/) to learn more.

*[Ben Mitchel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ben-mitchel-9833a41/) is Senior Director of Product Marketing and Business Development at Teradyne, where he leads market strategy and business growth for the company’s test solutions. With 30 years of experience across engineering, product line management, sales and general management, Ben has held senior roles at Teradyne, Asterion, SatCon Power Systems and Sycamore Networks. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from Worcester Polytechnic Institute and an MBA from the Isenberg School of Management at the University of Massachusetts Amherst.*
